name: disciple_the_order
description: a Disciple of the Order, a young tonsured monk of the Order's faith: short brown hair round a shaved crown, a youthful face, a long white robe with wide sleeves, a red cowl round his neck and shoulders, a red tabard with a gold sun emblem and gold edging, a red sash belt with a hanging tassel, brown shoes, a small steel flanged mace on a short wooden handle in his LEFT hand (screen-right), and a red holy book with gold corners clutched against his chest in his RIGHT arm (screen-left)
hands: the flanged mace stays in his left hand on the screen-right side and his right arm on the screen-left side holds the red holy book against his chest

flinch.0: impact: hit from the lower-right; head snaps back toward the upper-left, eyes squeezed shut, torso jolts back, both arms jerk outward (the arm holding the red holy book flung out to the left, the mace arm thrown up and out)
flinch.1: recoil extreme: leaning back further, knees bent, the mace dipping, the red holy book still held out

death.1: stagger back: a step back with the near foot, body thrown back, the mace arm flung up, the arm with the red holy book drooping
death.2: knees buckle: hips drop, knees fold forward, torso slumps forward, head droops, the mace lowering
death.3: kneeling: on both knees, slumped forward, the mace head resting on the ground, the arm with the red holy book hanging
death.4: falling back: torso tips back toward the upper-left, the mace slips out of the hand, legs slide forward, the white robe flaring
death.5: hits the ground: lying on his back along the ground, feet toward the lower-right and head toward the upper-left, the white robe spread; the mace lies on the ground at the lower-right; the red holy book lies beside him
death.6: bounce: head and shoulders lift slightly off the ground, the robe settles
death.7: corpse: lying flat and still on his back, eyes closed, the mace and the red holy book on the ground beside him
